comment: Segments to extract from baserom.gba (tools/split.py).
Names/kinds/boundaries come from docs/analysis/segments.txt; function
labels come from docs/analysis/symbols.csv. For every code segment
listed here, make split writes asm/<name>.s (verified byte-identical
against the ROM) and removes the data/<name>.s incbin slice; every data
segment becomes a structure-only data/<name>.s (issue #36,
docs/data.md): labels, symbolic pointer words and .incbin slices of
baserom.gba, never ROM values. linker.ld already pins each section by
name, so no linker script change is needed.
external_defined lists symbols that already exist as real labels in the
link (asm/crt0.s, src/agb_sram.c) and therefore must NOT be redefined
as absolute symbols in asm/rom_syms.s.
extra_labels forces a real `.global` label at an address inside one of
the configured segments: functions that never enter symbols.csv because
nothing bl-calls them (_call_via_r4..r7 of lesson 3.4, plus the rest of
the libgcc family up to lr) and named items inside data segments (the
SRAM save identifier string; the m4a engine rodata tables of issue
#51 — pret names, gCgb3Vol identified against pokeemerald's
m4a_tables.c by its NR32 channel-3 output-level byte pattern).
SoftReset (0x080CFA80, issue #29) is
deliberately an extra label and NOT a symbols.csv entry: the segment is
data-emitted (odd start 0x080CFA7F), so the label carries no Thumb
function mark, and resolving its two BL callers against it would make
ld insert an interworking veneer that shifts every later section; the
callers keep their raw .short BL pairs instead.
data_symbols names non-ROM word values so they can be emitted as
.word <name> from split literal pools; definitions land in rom_syms.s.
Values below are the IWRAM cells of the cooperative task system that
the ARM helpers at 0x08000234-0x080002E4 operate on (see
docs/analysis/rom-map.md section 6 for the per-cell evidence).
Segments with "chunk_bytes" are cut at even function boundaries
roughly that many bytes apart and emitted as one file per chunk under
asm/<segment>/ (<segment>_NN.s); all chunks share the segment's
linker section, so ld concatenates them in address order. Branches
that cross a chunk boundary resolve through global loc_XXXXXXXX
labels defined by the owning chunk (issue #25).
The gUnk_<addr> data_symbols are the IWRAM/EWRAM cells initialized by
AgbInit (src/agb_init.c, issue #28); the C references them as extern
symbols so their pool words stay one-per-symbol (no cross-cell address
derivation), matching the original codegen.
abs_symbols defines plain link-time constants (name -> value) emitted
into rom_syms.s WITHOUT pool-word renaming (data_symbols with values
like 0 or 4 would rename unrelated pool words everywhere). The m4a
driver reads its music-player count and max-lines limit as symbol
ADDRESSES: (u16)gNumMusicPlayers == 4 players (pool word 0x00000004
at 0x080CE5C8), (u32)gMaxLines == 0 (pool word at 0x080CE928), the
same SDK idiom katam's m4a.h documents (issue #53).
Data segments (issue #36, docs/data.md): every ROM address in
data_symbols and every extra_labels address inside a data segment is a
real label there. "asset": true on a segment turns off the blanket
code-pointer rule (graphics, samples, songs). pointer_tables lists the
tables whose words are pointers, each with the consumer that proves it
("why"): start plus end or count, stride and pointer offsets, optional
"targets" (the layout of the records it points at) or "extent":
"next-label" for a declared pointer array of unknown length. not_pointers
keeps a word inside its .incbin, with the reason.

not_pointers.0x0872EA04: sram_driver_fn_table[0] = ReadSram_Core+1, which src/agb_sram.c defines static (as the SDK source does), so no global symbol names it
not_pointers.0x0872EA0C: sram_driver_fn_table[2] = VerifySram_Core+1, static in src/agb_sram.c like ReadSram_Core

pointer_tables.why: task-type table gTaskTypes[266] {u8 class; entry}: TaskCreate (TaskCreate, src/early_5654.c) copies .unk04 into the slot's resume address gTaskResumeAddrs[], which the ARM switcher at 0x08000234 enters with bx (rom-map section 6)
gMPlayTable[4]: struct MusicPlayer {MusicPlayerInfo *info; MusicPlayerTrack *track; u8 unk_8; u16 unk_A} (include/gba/m4a_internal.h); m4aSoundInit (src/m4a_c1.c) opens each player from it
the room table gRoomTable[9][8]: struct RoomDef **gRoomTable[][8] indexed [level][stage] (levels 0-8, 8 = the hub; src/level_242d0.c, src/room_27e28.c), each entry a stage's room list or NULL
the BG animation script lists gRoomBgAnimScripts[i] points at: NULL-terminated struct Unk02007D70Cmd *[] that LoadRoomBgAnims (src/camera_2d01c.c) walks with while (list[i] != 0)
gRoomBgAnimScripts[]: struct Unk02007D70Cmd **gRoomBgAnimScripts[] indexed by RoomDef.unk40, entry 0 unused (src/camera_2d01c.c LoadRoomBgAnims)
the stage room lists gRoomTable[level][stage] points at: every word is gRoomTable[level][stage][room] (a struct RoomDef *, src/level_242d0.c) or the NULL after a stage's last room

targets.why: struct RoomDef (0x58 bytes, M07, src/room_27e28.c): maps unk08/unk0C, block table unk10, palettes unk18/unk28, tiles unk1C/unk2C, metatiles unk20, BG map unk30, doors unk44, object list unk48
